ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with approximately 12-15% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage concentrated in circular patterns and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed high-contrast white rings and focal spots across both lobes; solid high-intensity pixel blocks located at the extreme left and right lateral margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated interior angle of approximately 48 degrees relative to the lobe midlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern with pixel-amplitude variations of 3-10 pixels; higher frequency of peaks and valleys observed on the distal portions of both trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory from the median notch toward the distal tips along the trailing edge; the leading edge exhibits a contrasting convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Abundant circular high-contrast pixel clusters (rosettes) ranging from 4 to 12 pixels in diameter distributed globally across the visible ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced white calcified clusters (barnacle colonization) localized on the lateral-most tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct geometric pattern of empty circular white scars against dark pigment, forming a unique spatial distribution map across the fluke.
